$comment: Independent review filter record review_filter_record 1.0.0 (contracts 3.4.0; docs/dev/independent-review-spec.md section 5.5): what the filter agent of the optional filtering pass writes as filter_record.json in its attempt folder. One decision per pooled round-1 finding in the packet's findings.json: keep (the page should change) or drop (wrong, a preference, a duplicate or a setup artefact), with a reason. This schema is the single source of field names, enums and required fields for the filter instruction file, its output example and the receipt checks; the rules that need more than one field (one decision per finding, duplicate_of naming a kept finding) are Python rules in contracts/review.py (filter_record_rules, filter_receipt_codes). Fields the script cannot verify are marked self-reported.

packet_sha256.description: the sha256 of manifest.json in your packet folder: run `sha256sum manifest.json` there and copy the 64 hex digits

dispatch_nonce.description: the nonce= value of the second line of the dispatch message you were given, copied exactly

instructions_sha256.description: the sha256= value of the second line of the dispatch message; it equals `sha256sum instructions.md`

identity.description: your agent name or session label; it must differ from the author's

context.description: fresh for a new agent context, human for a person

host.description: the host program, for example claude-code

saw_prior_conversation.description: true when any earlier conversation is visible to you; then record it and stop

host_injected.description: categories of content the host added to your context (for example: memory file, environment notes)

instruction_files_seen.description: instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules) you can see, or unknown

paths_read.description: every local file you read, with the sha256 of the whole file (`sha256sum FILE`)

decisions.description: exactly one decision for every finding in findings.json

limitations.description: what you did not check; must not be blank

id.description: an identifier: a letter, then letters, digits, '_', '.', ':' or '-'

finding_id.description: the id of a finding in findings.json

decision.description: keep: the page should change; drop: the finding is wrong, a matter of preference, a duplicate of another finding, or an artefact of the review setup

duplicate_of.description: only for a drop that repeats another finding: the id of the kept finding it duplicates
